title: Manage Evolu relays and see synchronization errors
body:
Account settings now lets you add Evolu relays, inspect their details, enable or pause them, and remove custom relays. Satflux and Freedomrelay are the defaults; existing explicit relay selections and disabled settings are preserved.

Connection status is shown separately from observed protocol errors, including quota, write-key, write, synchronization and version failures. An open connection or a received reply does not confirm a complete backup.

After updating, keep your recovery phrase and independent invoicing exports safe, load account settings on each device, close all Satflux tabs and reopen.
